translations.about.heading: How Can I Help You?
translations.about.intro: Hello, I'm Mateusz Malich, a passionate Freelance Developer and AI Enthusiast ready to bring your ideas to life. With a strong engineering background, I build scalable applications, robust websites, and intelligent systems tailored to your specific goals. Here's how I can help transform your business through creative problem-solving and technical excellence:
translations.about.card.web.title: Web Development
translations.about.card.web.description: I design and develop modern, responsive websites and full-stack web applications tailored precisely to your business needs as a freelance developer. From high-converting landing pages to complex, data-driven platforms, I ensure every project is built with clean, maintainable code. My focus is on delivering performant, accessible, and highly SEO-friendly solutions that not only look great but also drive real measurable results for your growing digital presence.
translations.about.card.apps.title: Desktop & Mobile Apps
translations.about.card.apps.description: I build fast, secure, and easily scalable native and cross-platform applications designed for both desktop and mobile devices. By focusing on intuitive user interfaces and robust backend functionality, I guarantee a seamless user experience across all platforms. Whether you need an internal enterprise tool or a customer-facing mobile app, I leverage industry best practices to deliver reliable software that meets your users right where they are.
translations.about.card.ai.title: AI Implementation
translations.about.card.ai.description: As an AI enthusiast, I specialize in seamlessly integrating cutting-edge AI solutions directly into your existing business workflows. From intelligent customer service chatbots and automated data processing pipelines to advanced machine learning models and generative AI tools, I help you leverage the transformative power of artificial intelligence. Let's unlock new efficiencies, reduce operational costs, and discover innovative ways to stay ahead.
